questions.q: Our village lies ______ two high mountains.
You may write ______ a pen or ______ a pencil.

They went ______ a museum.
There were no planes ______ the past.
Marie Curie was born ______ Warsaw.
Chocolate ______ harmful for your teeth, but strawberries ______ useful for your health.
There ______ apple juice in the fridge. And apples ______ so delicious.
Would you like ______ chips?
Would you like ______ tea ______ mineral water?
A: Is there ______ juice in the fridge? B: No, there isn't ______ juice, but there is ______ lemonade.
